    Integral lifting of the nonzero-product Leibniz equations (Theorem 9.1(3)) #

    thm:integral-partial-lifting(3) and lem:one-sided-path-coefficients (integral-partial-lifts.tex). The equations eq:partial-leibniz-group are encoded by IsSol: a coefficient d r for each ray, zero on unshiftable rays, with d t = ε_L d r + ε_R d s on every nonzero product rs = t with shiftable output.

    Deviation: only part (3) is used (cor:zero-supported-coverage), and it is proved directly: from a solution modulo two we build an integer solution, by the coefficient formulas of the proof of Theorem 9.1 — the two-sided part from a lift ω of its restriction to the two-sided rays (the freeness of W_χ, from the induction hypothesis, enters only here), the coefficients of generating one-sided rays by the first-arrow recursion (lem:one-sided-path-coefficients, with paths replaced by unique first arrows), canonical integer lifts X_a, and Y_b read off from the rows (Lemma 9.5).
